items.title: WSL match report: Liverpool play out 0-0 draw with Chelsea in St Helens
items.excerpt: Liverpool played out a 0-0 draw with Barclays Women’s Super League leaders Chelsea on Saturday. Both sides carved out chances across the course of the clash at St Helens Stadium, with Khiara Keating outstanding in the Reds’ goal. Neither landed a mark on the scoresheet, though, and Gareth Taylor’s team made it four games unbeaten in all competitions. There was a liveliness from both sides without much in the way of major chances during the opening 20 minutes. Ellie Carpenter had the best sight of goal for the visitors as she raced free down the right and was able to move into the penalty area.

La rosa granata in questo reparto offre tante alternative, tante possibili combinazioni da sfruttare a seconda delle disponibilità e delle caratteristiche degli avversari. La rifinitura di ieri a Torino è servita a verificare le condizioni di Nikola Vlasic e di Rafik Belghali, tornati acciaccati dagli impegni con le nazionali, rispettivamente per un affaticamento al bicipite della coscia destra e per un dolore al ginocchio destro. items.excerpt: Le verdict et tombé, et il est lourd pour Harry Kane. items.title: Ex-captain Moody joins England side to face haka
items.description: Former England captain Lewis Moody joins the current team to face New Zealand's haka in an emotional start to Saturday's Test match at Allianz Stadium.
items.excerpt: Former England captain Lewis Moody joined the current team to face New Zealand's haka in an emotional start to Saturday's Test match at Allianz Stadium. Moody, who was diagnosed with motor neurone disease (MND) last year, stood at the centre of England's line-up - between captain Maro Itoje and one of the team's vice-captains, Ellis Genge - as they faced up to the traditional pre-match challenge. Led by Genge's fellow vice-captains Ollie Chessum and Jamie George, England then advanced to form a V shape, similar to the formation they took before last year's victory and the 2019 Rugby World Cup

items.title: Conceiçao torna a Parma dopo più di 20 anni. E se la Serie A lo chiamasse...
items.description: L'ex allenatore del Milan torna al Tardini, dove giocò nel 2000-01. Un suo futuro su una panchina italiana? Possibile, la Serie A è da sempre un suo pallino
items.excerpt: Sergio Conceiçao e Parma non si vedevano così da oltre vent'anni. Si troveranno un po’ cambiati, ma in fondo sempre loro. Lui senza ciuffo e con la barba che, quando cresce, è inevitabilmente bianca. Lei senza Cannavaro e Thuram, al massimo con Troilo e Delprato, che non sono la stessa cosa. Conceiçao è tornato al Tardini per Parma-Roma e nel suo piccolo è un evento. Ha giocato in quello stadio fino al 2001, ci è ripassato da avversario negli anni successivi, poi basta. Ognuno per la sua strada. Quando Sergio ha allenato il Milan, Parma non è stata sulla sua strada - ci aveva già giocato Fonse

items.title: England call up McKinney for South Africa Tests
items.description: England call up uncapped Durham opener Ben McKinney for the Test tour of South Africa after Jacob Bethell's injury withdrawal.
items.excerpt: England have called up uncapped Durham opener Ben McKinney for their Test tour of South Africa as cover for injured batter Jacob Bethell. The 22-year-old, a tall and attacking left-hander, has long been highly-rated by England and has now been rewarded with his first international call-up. It leaves McKinney's Durham team-mate Emilio Gay, Ben Duckett and Jordan Cox set to continue as England's top three after relative success through the summer. Bethell had been expected to rival Gay or Cox for a place in the top three before it was revealed he requires further surgery on a knee issue. McKinne

items.title: Un incroyable vol plané en MotoGP: l’énorme chute de Diogo Moreira au Portugal
items.description: Le pilote brésilien Diogo Moreira a été victime d’une impressionnante chute lors des qualifications du Grand Prix du Portugal, samedi à Portimao. Il s'en sort miraculeusement sans blessure.
items.excerpt: Marc Marquez peut bien chambrer Diogo Moreira en mimant des ailes avec ses bras. C’est un petit miracle si le pilote brésilien est toujours en piste ce week-end à l’occasion du Grand Prix du Portugal. Auteur du meilleur chrono en Q1, le pilote de 22 ans s'est-il senti poussé des ailes lors des qualifications samedi à Portimao ? En tout cas, il a pris tous les risques et perdu le contrôle de sa Honda à plus de 200km/h. Moreira est passé par-dessus son guidon - un high side - et a effectué un incroyable vol plané avant de finir loin de la piste, dans les graviers. Une chute terrible qui pouvait
